Featured post

WELCOME

RANDOM SELECTION

Pied Piper

We host a large collection of UK Hardcore music / Jungle music / Drum & Bass music / Happy Hardcore music / Techno music / UK Garage music digitised rave tapes DJ mixes of cassette tape packs from the 1990s and 2000s.

We are constantly adding to the collection and strive to provide high quality audio and complete (digital) tape packs.

‘FRESH RIPS’ are ravetapepacks.com original cassette tape to mp3 one-to-one conversions which are the same as playing the original tape.

This entry was posted in Welcome on July 13, 2014 by raveradmin.
